name: True USB Write Progress+
description:
A top-bar widget that monitors real-time pending background writes to removable USB storage, showing true dirty-cache flush progress so you know exactly when a drive is safe to eject.

This fork shows a real percentage and progress bar: it watches the files being copied to the drive and compares their total size with the bytes actually flushed to the device. Click the indicator for per-drive details and a "Flush now" button that writes cached data immediately. "Safe to eject" is only announced once the data is really on the device. Works with LUKS-encrypted drives.

Fork of True USB Write Progress by Ashen Chathuranga (ktauchathuranga).
